$comment: MAIN SETTINGS FILE. Fill in every empty value marked REQUIRED before publishing. Secrets (API keys, FTP passwords) never go here - put them in the .env file (see .env.example). See docs/CONFIGURATION.md for an explanation of every setting.

shop.name: Kinusaiga Pattern
shop.tagline: Printable Kinusaiga patterns and no-sew Japanese fabric art templates
shop.siteUrl_help: REQUIRED before publishing. Your real domain with https and no trailing path, e.g. https://www.your-domain.com
shop.contactEmail_help: REQUIRED. A real inbox customers can write to. Shown on Contact, Help and policy pages.
shop.contactFormEndpoint_help: Optional. URL of an external form service (for example Formspree). Leave empty to use an email link only.
shop.businessLocation_help: Optional but recommended for trust and legal pages, e.g. 'United States'.
shop.supportResponseTime_help: Optional, e.g. 'within 2 business days'. Leave empty to show no promise.

source.rootPath_help: Leave empty to use 'This PC > Documents > A To Copy' automatically. Or enter a full path such as D:\\Products\\A To Copy
source.freeIdRange_help: Products whose number is inside this range are FREE (K1-K12). Everything else is PAID.

vision.enabled_help: Optional. When true and GEMINI_API_KEY is set in .env, the importer asks an AI vision model to write image-specific alt text. Results are saved and reused.

checkoutSheet.csvUrl_help: Google Sheet published/exported as CSV (File > Share > Publish to web > CSV), or set CHECKOUT_SHEET_CSV_URL in .env instead. Columns: product_id, payhip_link
checkoutSheet.range_help: Used only with the Google Sheets API (needs GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY in .env).
checkoutSheet.localCsvPath_help: Used when no Google Sheet is configured. Same two columns.

payhip.buttonMode_help: 'embed' = official Payhip Buy Now button (opens Payhip checkout overlay). 'link' = plain link to Payhip.
payhip.embedTheme_help: Payhip button theme. 'none' lets this website style the button green to match the design. Other Payhip themes: 'green', 'blue', 'grey'.
payhip.verifyOnline_help: During import, open each Payhip page and check that its title mentions the product subject. Only a helper - you still approve every link.
payhip.lifetimeAccess_help: Set to true ONLY if your Payhip settings give buyers unlimited/lifetime download access.

offering.help: Which file/size package is VERIFIED for paid and free products. Set paidProfile to 'standard-10' once confirmed.

catalog.featuredIds_help: Optional list such as ["K24", "K53"]. Products can also be featured in data/overrides.
catalog.showDraftsInDev_help: Local preview only (npm run dev): shows draft products with a DRAFT banner. Drafts are NEVER included in the production build.

integrations.googleSiteVerification_help: Google Search Console HTML-tag verification code (content value only).
integrations.ga4MeasurementId_help: Optional, e.g. G-XXXXXXX. Loaded only after the visitor accepts analytics cookies.

adsense.client_help: Optional, e.g. ca-pub-1234567890. Disabled by default; loaded only after consent.
